messages:
maya: uploaded model artifacts for "archai-xlarge-2026-rc1" to s3://incoming/models/archai-xlarge-2026-rc1/
maya: transfer finished at 13:02 PT, manifest attached. Need provenance verification (checksums, signer, license) + registry entry. Who can take lead? :eyes:
jonathan: I can take owner for ingest. Will run checksum & signature verify. Tagging @sophia for tokenizer validation.
sophia: on it. I'll run tokenizer tests + vocab sanity. ETA ~30m.
eli: FYI ops-bot already created an ingest job id: ingest-4837. Logs: https://ingest.internal/ingest-4837. Upload size 54GB, multipart parts: 42.
ops-bot: ingest job ingest-4837 created by maya. Status: uploaded -> pending-verify.
jonathan: running initial checks:
1) compute sha256 for weights and tokenizer
2) verify signature: gpg --verify model.tar.gz.sig model.tar.gz
3) compare computed checksum to vendor manifest
snippet:
```
sha256sum model.tar.gz > model.sha256
gpg --verify model.tar.gz.sig model.tar.gz
aws s3 cp s3://incoming/models/archai-xlarge-2026-rc1/model.sha256 -
```

sophia: tokenizer checks I will run:
- confirm vocab size == 50288
- roundtrip encode/decode on edge-case prompts
- verify tokenizer_hash against vendor manifest
I'll push tokenizer_hash to registry if all pass.
maya: license is Apache-2.0 per vendor manifest. Uploaded objects are KMS-encrypted.
jonathan: quick note — computed sha256 differs from vendor manifest (manifest: abc123..., computed: def456...). Reassembling to double-check.
eli: ops-bot: check object ETag; multipart uploads can make ETag differ.
ops-bot: S3 ETag: "7c9a...-42" for model.tar.gz. Ingest job flagged for multipart ETag.
maya: vendor says their client finished upload and provided signed manifest. Sending now.
jonathan: plan if mismatch persists:
- request vendor-signed chunk manifest
- run byte-level header check (first 8 bytes)
- if still mismatch, reject ingest and ask for reupload with signer metadata
sophia: tokenizer unit tests passed. vocab hash: 9f3b... attaching to registry pending weights verify.
maya: also received quantization artifacts from vendor: q8_0 static scales + config qconfig.json. Want registry variant name: "int8-static-vendor".
eli: ops: if we accept, move artifacts to registry path: s3://redwood-registry/private/archai-xlarge/2026-rc1/{weights,tokenizer,quant,manifest} and create symlink latest -> 2026-rc1. Add retention tags.
jonathan: will run a small smoke generation (5 prompts) against the unpacked weights to check glaring regressions. Eval job id: eval-9002.
sophia: add tokenizer regression tests for weird newline sequences and long hyphenated words.
maya: vendor provided GPG signature id 0xBEEF. Also a vendor release id: acme-ai-release-20260302.
jonathan: update — after reassemble and verifying vendor-signed chunk manifest, sha256 now matches vendor manifest. False alarm (multipart assembly edge-case).
eli: flipping ingest job to VERIFIED. Requesting registry write.
ops-bot: ingest-4837 status -> verified by jonathan at 1765432130. Registry write initiated.
ops-bot: registry write job reg-742 created. Destination: s3://redwood-registry/private/archai-xlarge/2026-rc1/
maya: registry metadata payload (to be added):
- architecture: "decoder-only"
- dims: "70B"
- tokenizer_hash: "9f3b..."
- weights_sha256: "def456..."
- license: "Apache-2.0"
- origin: "vendor-uploads/acme-ai"
- quant_variants: ["int8-static-vendor"]
- signer: "vendor-gpg-0xBEEF"
- ingest_job: "ingest-4837"
jonathan: also add smoke_eval_id: "eval-9002" and quality_gate: "basic-smoke-pass" to registry metadata.
sophia: please add retention tag: "private-retain-3y" on registry objects.
maya: thanks all — I'll draft a short runbook for handoff + create a PR to the registry-index with the metadata link.
jonathan: leaving a checklist for next time:
- require vendor chunk-manifest + gpg-signed manifest on first upload
- automated ETag vs part-count sanity check in ingest-bot
- automatic tokenizer quick test run
- smoke_eval kicked off by registry write precommit
eli: noted. Closing loop: ops-bot will emit final audit event when reg-742 completes.
ops-bot: registry write reg-742 status -> in-progress.
maya: thanks everyone :tada:
